items.definition:
an argument or fight
They had a bit of a barney over who should pay the bill.

a person or company that makes beer
The local brewer is known for their craft ales.

the base frame of a car, bus, or other vehicle
The car's chassis was damaged in the accident.

the action of making something clearer or easier to understand
Could you provide some clarification on that point?

comfort received by a person after a loss or disappointment
She found consolation in her friends' support.

a short knife with a pointed, double-edged blade
He pulled a small dagger from his belt.

conduct or transactions, especially in business
His dealings with the company were always transparent.

a particular form of a language peculiar to a specific region or social group
She spoke in a regional dialect that was hard to understand.

a loss of power, prosperity, or status; ruin
His arrogance led to his downfall.

a disadvantage or negative aspect
The only downside of the plan is the cost.

a special or instinctive aptitude or ability for doing something well
She has a flair for dramatic fashion.

a person who has escaped from captivity or is in hiding
The police are searching for the fugitive.

a problem or difficulty that must be overcome
Lack of funding was a major hurdle for the project.

words or symbols written or carved on something
The old bell had an inscription with the date it was made.

a person or thing that is likely to cause harm; a threat or danger
The stray dog was a menace to the local wildlife.

a colorless, odorless flammable gas that is the main constituent of natural gas
Methane is a potent greenhouse gas.

the incorrect or improper use of something
The misuse of company funds led to his dismissal.

a feeling of sickness with an urge to vomit
The motion of the boat caused him to feel nausea.

the state of being important or famous
The issue has gained prominence in recent debates.

Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
Many veterans suffer from PTSD.

a person who has run away
The police are searching for the teenage runaway.

the script of a film
She spent months writing the screenplay for the movie.

a group of people with somewhat different religious beliefs
The small sect broke away from the main church.

the captain of a boat or aircraft
The skipper guided the ship through the storm.

a secret store of something
He kept a secret stash of candy in his drawer.

a large tank or tub
The wine was fermented in a large wooden vat.

the place where someone or something is
His current whereabouts are unknown.

a type of brick made of sun-dried earth and straw
Many traditional houses in the desert are built from adobe.

a desirable or useful feature
The hotel offers many amenities, including a swimming pool.

a mixture of dark bituminous pitch with sand or gravel
The road was paved with fresh asphalt.

the series of vertebrae extending from the skull to the pelvis
The human backbone protects the spinal cord.

the way a character is described or portrayed
The author's characterization of the villain was very detailed.

the wife or widow of a count or earl
The countess wore a beautiful gown to the ball.

any of a group of spore-producing organisms feeding on organic matter
Mushrooms are a type of fungus.

the firing of guns
The sound of gunfire echoed through the streets.

a humorous or malicious deception
The bomb threat turned out to be a hoax.

a person or company that provides insurance
You should contact your insurer after the accident.

women's underwear and nightclothes
She bought some new lingerie for her wedding.

soft, fatty tissue inside bones
Bone marrow is essential for producing blood cells.

short for mononucleosis or monophonic sound
He was diagnosed with mono after feeling tired for weeks.

a chess piece of the lowest value; a person used by others
He felt like a mere pawn in their political game.

a limited quantity of something
Each salesperson has a monthly sales quota to meet.

a small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been removed
There was a sticky residue left on the counter.

water from rain or melted snow that flows over the ground surface
Agricultural runoff can pollute rivers and lakes.

the act of providing staff
The company is facing challenges with staffing for the new project.

a part of a larger group
This group of students is a subset of the entire class.

a state of anxious uncertainty
The movie built up a lot of suspense towards the end.

a small amount
Could you move it a tad to the left?

a gland in the neck
The doctor checked her thyroid during the examination.

an act of waiving a right or claim
You need to sign a waiver before participating in the activity.

a system of wires
The old house needed new electrical wiring.

a hormone released in stress
The sudden fright caused an adrenaline rush.

distinctive atmosphere or quality
The old house had an aura of mystery.

a covering, usually of cloth, supported on poles or a frame
The trees formed a dense green canopy over the path.

a large, fast warship; a type of motorcycle or car
The police cruiser sped down the highway.

the state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else
The country's dependency on oil imports is a concern.

the size or frequency of a dose of medicine or radiation
Always follow the recommended dosage for the medication.

a book or set of books giving information on many subjects
He looked up the information in the encyclopedia.

the act of improving or enhancing the quality or value of something
The program offers educational enrichment for children.

an act or instance of erupting
The volcanic eruption caused widespread ashfall.

a person who examines
The examiner asked a difficult question.

a federal agent or the Federal Reserve
The Fed raised interest rates.

the action of beginning something or a ceremony
The initiation ceremony was very old.

a state of isolation or restricted access
The city went into lockdown to control the virus.
